_law: id_detection_order and prompt_detection_order are SEPARATELY encoded (sdlab v2 product law — never flatten into one list). id-order follows the canon listing convention; prompt-order is tuned so the most-specific faction keywords resolve first and the generic scavenger vocabulary (salvage/cargo) cannot steal a record.

communion.label: Rust Communion
communion.description: The under-city salvaged-machine empathy faith — venerates extracted android memory-cores as reliquary relics. Cast: Scrap-Saint, Rustblood, Hearthframe.

scrip.label: Scrip (scavengers)
scrip.description: The scavenger-pragmatic wing — scrap-rivers, cargo hauling, salvage and price-tags. Cast: Gutterjack, Dockrat, Hushwire.

decommissioned.label: Decommissioned (militant)
decommissioned.description: The militant/scarred wing — decommissioned enforcers and veterans, weaponized and hard. Cast: Rustgrave, Ironclad, Gristle (Welded).

keeper.label: Keeper (archival)
keeper.description: The archival wing — keeper of certificates, manifests, and the failing-empathy death-records. Cast: Dustwhisper.

training_profiles.intended_use: Hesperia world + cast concept-art reference set rendered in the rustline house style — for review, eval, and as an on-canon reference corpus. NOT a new style-training set (Hesperia consumes the rustline LoRA, it does not train one).
